(ns omega.live.worker)

(defn accepts [message] (erlang/is_binary message))
(defn state-valid [value] (and (erlang/is_integer value) (>= value 0)))
(defn migrate [value] value)
(defn upcast [message] message)
(defn handler [message value]
  (let [delta 5
        next (if (= message "inc") (+ value delta) value)]
    {:reply next :state next}))
(defn definition [version digest]
  {:version version :digest digest :accept? accepts :check-state state-valid
   :handler handler :migrate-state migrate :upcast upcast})
